this_title: The Best of 'Autopsy': A Sex Crimes Special
introduction: In this seventh 'Autopsy,' the most bone-chilling sex-crime stories from past specials are exhumed. Segments include: a prison guard's killer is found thanks to bite marks; a plastic bag becomes a vital clue when it turns out to contain the faceprint of a murdered woman; pine needles in a hair braid lead police to the body of a woman missing for nearly 20 years.- Fromhttp://play.hbogo.com/feature/urn:hbo:feature:GVWie-Aucv8LDwwIJAACv
